1 (Currently Amended): A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a __non-rigid__ seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw.

3 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than __0.050 inches__.

7 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is __distinct from any previously recited tapered fluid conduit__.

9 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the __non-rigid__ seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal.

10 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the __non-rigid__ seal.

11 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the __non-rigid__ seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi.
